one_liner: Turns an ecommerce product catalog into designed, on-brand image and video ads automatically, so every SKU gets scroll-stopping creative instead of a plain packshot.
category: Ecommerce SaaS - catalog / dynamic product ad creative
target_customers: Ecommerce and DTC brands with 20+ products running catalog (dynamic product) ads on Meta, TikTok, Google and Pinterest; growth marketers, performance agencies and in-house creative teams
problems_solved: Catalog ads look like plain white-background packshots, designing creative per SKU doesn't scale, prices/promos in creatives go stale, and there's no video for catalog ads
key_features: Catalog/feed sync (Shopify, WooCommerce, Meta/Google feeds), branded image templates with live price, discount, rating and badge overlays, catalog-to-video templates, bulk per-SKU rendering, auto-refresh when the feed changes, creative A/B testing
differentiators: Images AND video from the catalog, self-serve set-up in minutes, priced for growing brands rather than enterprise-only
competitors: Marpipe, Confect, Hunch, Pencil, in-house design + Canva
brand_voice: Friendly, confident and performance-minded: plain words, ROAS-first, no jargon
extra_notes: Pricing should scale with catalog size, channels and video volume. Add-ons and an agency plan support expansion revenue.
